facts.fact: 离开 Aaron 将近三年的日子，仍让 Kayla 被侵入感抓住
facts.anchor: It’s been three years almost to the day that I left Aaron, yet he still gets inside my head

facts.fact: Kayla 靠一把推得太整齐的椅子确认有人来过
facts.anchor: The chair at the table is pushed in perfectly, but I never push it back in

facts.fact: Kayla 忍住没先打给 Vero，怕他误判危险而螺旋
facts.anchor: If he wasn’t the one to come here, it might cause him to spiral if he thinks I’m in danger

facts.fact: Clay 排除 Vero 嫌疑：他的行事从不隐秘
facts.anchor: You know Vero. If he came here, he wouldn’t be secretive. You would have known about it

facts.fact: Clay 从床下捡到一截断粉笔，Kayla 的「想多了」因此存疑
facts.anchor: Nothing, just a piece of broken chalk

facts.fact: Clay 要求 Kayla 瞒住 Vero 与 Brawley，怕 Vero 因威胁感螺旋
facts.anchor: Vero has just come out of an episode, and I don’t want to give him something to spiral over

facts.fact: Clay 说出另一位妹妹的名字：Meeka，介于他与 Jess 之间
facts.anchor: My other sister’s name is Meeka

facts.fact: Clay 在车上立誓：有人伤她他不只还击而是杀人，Kayla 坚持交给警察
facts.anchor: If anyone tries to hurt you, Kayla, I won’t just hurt them. I will kill them
